reason: Concrete long-side daily-bar breakout rules on US momentum/growth stocks with market filter, patterns, and position sizing.
style: breakout from flags/tight consolidations after 50-70% move

universe.description: US stocks with institutional quality volume (5-100M+ daily dollar volume depending on theme maturity), RS rating >=90

setup.rule: High relative strength and accumulation on volume
setup.quote: relative strength so how performs a stock in comparison with the indices ... how is the the accumulation of a stock uh when you watch the volume

setup.rule: Big prior move then tight consolidation around EMA8/21
setup.quote: when when a stock makes a big move like 50 or 70% in a short period of time and then it get gets very tight and starts to consolidate around the exponential moving average 8 or exponential moving average 21

entry.rule: Breakout from flag, cup-handle or tight consolidation on volume
entry.quote: 90% of my trades are breakouts from uh classical chart patterns

stop.rule: Tight stop implied by pattern; risk 0.5-1.5% per trade
stop.quote: instead of risking let's say 0.5 to to 1% of my trading capital I risk a little bit more like you know one to one and a half%

exits.rule: Partial or full exit on breakdown or profit target (unspecified)
exits.quote: I have some some rules when to take profits, when to enter a stock

sizing.rule: 10-15% per position in good markets, 5-10% sideways, up to 20-25% high-conviction liquid names
sizing.quote: in good market periods, I invest 10 to 15% in one position ... I can also go up to 20 20% position size. So Tesla as an example or Nvidia, I had last year I had a 25% position in Nvidia

market_filter.rule: Market trend model on MAs green + new highs + stocks above MA200
market_filter.quote: I'm I'm running my own market trend model ... based on moving averages. And when I see a good trend in the stock market, so when my market trend model switches to green, when I see that there are a lot of stocks reaching new highs and we have a higher number of stocks above the MA200

ambiguities.issue: No exact values for momentum_lookback_days, consolidation_days, consolidation_max_range_pct, trail_ma, partial_after_days, partial_frac, max_positions
ambiguities.assumption: Use standard breakout template defaults where unspecified; focus on quoted 50-70% prior move and EMA8/21 consolidation
